data.name: Emana
data.gender_notes: Emana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Emana is an Arabic name that signifies strong faith and belief in Allah. It is a virtuous name that symbolizes a person's trust in their creator. The name Emana carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emana usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Emana is referred to as one of the pillars of Iman (faith), as mentioned in the Hadith of Gabriel.
data.etymology: Emana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emana total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إيمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإيمان هو التصديق بالجزم واليقين التام بوجود الله تعالى والإيمان بالرسل والكتب السماوية والملائكة واليوم الآخر والقدر خيره وشره. اسم إيمان مشتق من الأمانة ومعناه أيضا الثقة والطمأنينة في القلب.

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمان کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ پر مکمل یقین و اطمینان رکھنا۔ ایمان لانے کا مطلب ہے اللہ، فرشتوں، کتب آسمانی، رسل، آخرت اور تقدیر کے خیر و شر پر विश्वास کرنا۔

in_hindi.name: ईमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईमान का अर्थ है परमात्मा पर अटूट विश्वास और आत्म-शांति। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है सच्चाई, निष्ठा और धार्मिकता।

in_pashto.name: ایمان
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالی باندې باور او ایمان
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمان د الله تعالی پر یقین او باور دی. ایمان راوړل د دې ل معنی ده چې پر الله، فرښتو، کتبو، راسلو، اخرت او تقدیر یې خیر او شر باور ولري.

in_english.name: Emana
in_english.long_meaning: Emana is derived from the Arabic root 'Aman' which signifies faith, trust, and loyalty. In Islamic context, it relates to having firm belief in Allah, the prophets, and the hereafter. The name symbolizes sincerity, devotion, and spiritual commitment.
